analyzer.name: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA)
analyzer.license: MIT (package metadata inspected; third-party notices still apply)
analyzer.source_review_depth: Inspected server registration, browser observation/scenario, CDP capture, Playwright scenario, safe metadata, execution boundary and evidence/service layers. This is a source map, not a runtime test.
analyzer.use: MCP/CLI workflow for supported browser, local application, and artifact analysis; pair with direct GitHub source review for public repositories
limitations: Local REA process/MCP handshake was not run in this session.
No target repository was cloned, installed, or executed.
A website URL reveals observable page behavior/public assets only, not hidden private server source.
Native analyzers may require local providers such as Ghidra, Hopper or IDA.

priority_definitions.P1: Closest to operating core: agent framework, task execution, skills, MCP, model routing, coding/repo workflows, auth
priority_definitions.P2: Useful supporting SDKs, API adapters, UI clients and common tools
priority_definitions.P4: Relevance, provenance, maintenance, terms, safety or licensing needs careful triage first
